# Strict live-run structural fixture

`strict-live-run.br.b64` is a Brotli-compressed, length-delimited test fixture
covering the complete 24-trial, 11,520-row live `firstInstance` artifact shape.
The test inflates it only into an operating-system temporary directory.

Machine-local identifiers and resident-process identities are replaced with
synthetic fixture values. Candidate source provenance and the environment
decision are generated by the test, including a deliberate non-replaceable
pre/post process-set mismatch. This fixture exists only to exercise strict
private verification, public derivation, and independent public verification;
it is not benchmark evidence and must not be used for performance claims.
